description: The plot illustrates how BLEU varies with Average Lagging (AL) for multiple methods, shown as four lines. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 1 to 8, with labeled ticks at 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 20 to 30 with labeled ticks every 2 units (20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30). The “Consistency-CE” line is light purple with circular markers and a dashed style, increasing from about 20.1 at AL≈1 to about 29.7 at AL=8, passing through roughly 22.3 (AL=2), 25.2 (AL=3), 27.4 (AL=4), and about 29.0 (AL=6). The “Inconsistency-CE” line is dark purple with square markers and a dashed style, rising from about 22.3 at AL≈1 to about 29.8 at AL=8, with intermediate points near 26.6 (AL=3), 28.3 (AL=4), and about 29.4 (AL=6). The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” line is blue with square markers and a dashed style, increasing from about 22.3 at AL≈1 to about 29.5 at AL=8, with values around 26.2 (AL=3), 27.9 (AL=4), and about 28.9 (AL=6). The fourth line is red with star markers and a solid style, increasing from about 24.9 at AL≈1 to about 30.1 at AL=8, with intermediate values near 27.2 (AL=3), 28.9 (AL=4), and about 29.8 (AL=6).
